newsitem.title: USA: Cornerstone to pay special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Cornerstone to pay special dividend.

text.p: Cornerstone Bank said Friday that its board of directors declared at its regularly scheduled meeting a special cash dividend of $0.065 per share, payable on February 14, 1997, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on January 31, 1997.
The special cash dividend is an increase over the 1996 special dividend of $0.05 and is in addition to the regular quarterly dividend of $0.0466 cents.
